text:
marta_cs: FYI — Oxbridge (dedicated trial) token & embed traffic dropped sharply overnight to ~8% of normal. Renewal in ~28 days. Can we triage before AM sync? :warning:

ken_se: On it. Any 5xx/401/429 spikes or did they throttle jobs?

leah_data: Quick slice: tokens/hr baseline ~3.2k -> 260 yesterday. Error mix: 5% 401, 12% 429, small 5xx. Drop window starts ~2025-12-20 23:45 UTC. Chart: internal dash link (private).

olim_ae: Oxbridge PM said procurement started a short POC with MeridianAI and also asked infra to gate outbound traffic through a new proxy yesterday evening. They paused some nightly bulk embeds for cost reasons.

maya_onboard: Onboarding logs show many client-side retries and a few aborted warmups after the proxy cutover. Could be rate limiting + paused jobs.

incident_bot: [ALERT] customer-oxbridge: sudden-usage-drop detected. Runbook: cs-triage-network + cs-triage-usage. Incident ID: INC-OXB-20251220-3

ken_se: Running synthetics against their dedicated host and checking edge rate limiter config. If proxy IPs aren't allowlisted we could be getting 429s early in the flow.

ken_se: (after tests) Synthetics: 40/50 OK, 10% 429. Edge logs show bursts from a small new CIDR that hit token-bucket limits. Validator still healthy (low 401s). Looks like proxy -> backoff -> job pauses compounded the drop.

leah_data: SQL used (quick):

```
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) hr, sum(tokens) tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE customer = 'oxbridge'
  AND ts >= now() - interval '10 days'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 72;
```

marta_cs: Proposed immediate actions:
- Ken: add the proxy CIDR to org allowlist and temporarily raise bucket for oxbridge to absorb retries (owner: @ken_se). ETA 45m.
- Maya: push warmup script + a short restart checklist and offer a guided restart (owner: @maya_onboard). ETA 3h.
- OIim: reach out to procurement contact (J. Patel) and offer a two-week cost-safety bundle + free embed audit vs MeridianAI (owner: @olim_ae). ETA EOD.
- Leah: prepare hour-by-hour baseline vs drop chart for QBR (owner: @leah_data). ETA 2h.

maya_onboard: Will include recommended chunk sizes and a safe resume example to avoid bill surprise.

ken_se: Applied temporary allowlist and raised token bucket for the org. 429s dropped from 12% -> 1.5% in 15m. Monitoring link: internal infra.

incident_bot: [RECOVERY] INC-OXB-20251220-3: traffic recovered to ~86% baseline after allowlist and warmup restart. Incident auto-resolved.

olim_ae: J. Patel receptive to cost-safety bundle. I'll draft outreach and propose a 30-min demo comparing embedding cost/throughput vs Meridian.

marta_cs: Nice work. If traffic doesn't hold >75% baseline for 24h escalate to renewal-engage. Follow-ups: Ken monitor edge buckets, Maya confirm restart success, Leah finalize slide, OIim send outreach. Reconvene only if regression. :thumbsup:
